verdict.rationale: Loops docs confirm campaigns can be created (drafted) via the Content API, but the same docs explicitly state 'Review and send from the dashboard,' meaning the actual sending/scheduling step still requires the dashboard rather than being fully API-driven. No evidence of an API endpoint to schedule or trigger a broadcast's send time end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint to schedule/send a campaign, evidence of full dashboard-free workflow, independent confirmation of API-only campaign lifecycle.
